tasks.label: Install Starship in all terminals
tasks.command: touch ~/.bashrc && grep -qxF 'eval "$(starship init bash)"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'eval "$(starship init bash)"' >> ~/.bashrc; touch ~/.zshrc && grep -qxF 'eval "$(starship init zsh)"' ~/.zshrc || echo 'eval "$(starship init zsh)"' >> ~/.zshrc; mkdir -p ~/.config/powershell && touch ~/.config/powershell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1 && grep -qxF 'Invoke-Expression (&starship init powershell)' ~/.config/powershell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1 || echo 'Invoke-Expression (&starship init powershell)' >> ~/.config/powershell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1; echo 'Starship configurado en Bash, Zsh y PowerShell'

tasks.label: Start Aseprite
tasks.command: DIR="${workspaceFolder}/${input:asepriteProjectSelect}"; mkdir -p ~/.config/aseprite && touch ~/.config/aseprite/aseprite.ini && if grep -q 'current_folder' ~/.config/aseprite/aseprite.ini; then sed -i "s|^current_folder = .*|current_folder = $DIR|" ~/.config/aseprite/aseprite.ini; else echo -e "\n[file_selector]\ncurrent_folder = $DIR" >> ~/.config/aseprite/aseprite.ini; fi; cd "$DIR" && aseprite

tasks.label: Install .NET profiler
tasks.command: dotnet tool install --global dotnet-trace; export PATH="$PATH:/home/ubuntu/.dotnet/tools"

tasks.label: Start Profiler Server
tasks.command: mkdir -p .traces && NEXT=$(ls .traces/profile-*.nettrace 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*profile-\([0-9]*\)\.nettrace/\1/p' | sort -n | tail -1); NEXT=$(printf "%03d" $((10#${NEXT:-0} + 1))) && export PATH="$PATH:/home/ubuntu/.dotnet/tools" && rm -f /tmp/godot-diag && dotnet-trace collect --diagnostic-port /tmp/godot-diag --output ".traces/profile-${NEXT}.nettrace"

tasks.label: Stop Profiler & Convert Trace
tasks.command: export PATH="$PATH:/home/ubuntu/.dotnet/tools" && pkill -INT dotnet-trace && while pgrep dotnet-trace > /dev/null; do sleep 1; done && LATEST=$(ls -t .traces/profile-*.nettrace 2>/dev/null | head -n 1) && if [ -n "$LATEST" ]; then FMT="${input:traceFormatSelect}"; if [ "$FMT" != "none" ]; then dotnet-trace convert --format "$FMT" "$LATEST" && echo "¡Trace convertido exitosamente a formato $FMT!"; else echo "¡Trace conservado en formato raw: $LATEST!"; fi; fi
